/.title: Munib Tracker — Prayer Times, Salah & Qaza Tracker
/.description: A free, offline-first Islamic companion. Track your five daily prayers, qaza, and dhikr; read the Qur'an and hadith; and get accurate prayer times, qibla, and gentle reminders.

/achievements.title: Achievements
/achievements.description: Milestones, badges, and your devotion level.

/adhkar-builder.title: My Adhkar — Build Your Own
/adhkar-builder.description: Save your own zikr and supplications with Arabic, transliteration, translation, and reference, kept together for quick access.

/aqeedah.title: Learn Aqeedah — Islamic Beliefs
/aqeedah.description: The foundational beliefs of Islam from the Qur'an and authentic Sunnah — the six articles of faith, tawheed, and shirk, explained clearly with scholarly care.

/aqeedah/glossary.title: Aqeedah Glossary
/aqeedah/glossary.description: Key terms used in Islamic creed — tawheed, shirk, qadr, and more — defined clearly. Understanding the vocabulary prevents confusion when studying aqeedah.

/aqeedah/progress.title: My Aqeedah Learning Progress
/aqeedah/progress.description: Mark aqeedah topics complete as you study. This tracks your learning, not your standing with Allah.

/battles.title: Battles in Islam — Early History
/battles.description: The authentic history, context, lessons, and outcomes of the major battles in early Islam — Badr, Uhud, the Trench, and more, cited from Qur'an and hadith.

/battles/figures.title: Companions of the Early Battles
/battles/figures.description: Profiles of the leaders and heroes of the early battles, linked to the campaigns they joined — focused on role, contribution, and lessons, not tribal glory.

/battles/glossary.title: Battles Glossary
/battles/glossary.description: Terms used in Islamic military history — ghazwah, sariyyah, shura, and more — defined to prevent confusion between expedition types and general teachings.

/battles/lessons.title: Lessons from the Battles
/battles/lessons.description: The leadership and spiritual takeaways from each battle — character, shura, patience, and trust in Allah. Moral lessons, not military tactics.

/battles/progress.title: My Battles Learning Progress
/battles/progress.description: Track the battle topics you have read. Knowledge is a means; sincerity with Allah is the goal.

/battles/timeline.title: Battles Timeline
/battles/timeline.description: An interactive chronology from revelation through the Farewell Pilgrimage, with links to each battle. Dates follow Ibn Ishaq, Ibn Hisham, and Ibn Kathir.

/battles/verses.title: Qur'an Verses on the Battles
/battles/verses.description: Verses revealed in connection with the battles, with Arabic, translation, and historical context. Tap a verse to open it in the Qur'an reader.

/bookmarks.title: Bookmarks & Saved Reading
/bookmarks.description: All of your saved ayahs, hadith, duas, and adhkar in one place.

/calendar.title: Worship Calendar
/calendar.description: Review your prayers day by day across the month.

/credits.title: Credits & Data Sources
/credits.description: The open datasets, translations, and recitation audio that power Munib Tracker, with licenses and attribution for every source.

/dua.title: Duas & Supplications — Sunnah and Quranic
/dua.description: A collection of authentic duas and supplications — Sunnah, Quranic, and daily. Read the Arabic, transliteration, and meaning, and save your favorites offline.

/dua/favorites.title: Saved Duas
/dua/favorites.description: Your saved duas, kept together for quick return.

/duroods.title: Duroods & Salawat — Blessings upon the Prophet ﷺ
/duroods.description: Recite Durood and Salawat — sending blessings upon the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ. Read the Arabic, transliteration, and meaning of well-known salawat offline.

/events.title: Islamic Events — Hijri Calendar
/events.description: Upcoming dates in the Hijri year — the Islamic New Year, Ashura, Ramadan, Laylat al-Qadr, the two Eids, and more, with the significance of each day.

/hadith.title: Hadith Collections — Sayings of the Prophet ﷺ
/hadith.description: Browse authentic hadith from the major collections. Read the sayings and traditions of the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ offline, with narrator and grading details.

/hadith/bookmarks.title: Hadith Bookmarks
/hadith/bookmarks.description: Your saved hadith, kept together for quick return.

/hajj.title: Дастури Hajj ва Umrah
/hajj.description: Hajj ва Umrah-ро аз Qur'an ва Sunnah-и эътимоднok омӯзед, сонан маросимҳоро бо рӯйхатҳои алohidaи Hajj ва Umrah пайгирӣ кунед — хulasai ta'limii amalӣ, дастури fiqh нест.

/hayd.title: Hayd & Worship — Menstruation Guide
/hayd.description: What the texts teach about menstruation and daily worship — hayd, istihada, and nifas, when to pause and resume salah and fasting, and the ghusl that follows.

/jahannam.title: Understanding Jahannam — Hell in Islam
/jahannam.description: Understand the warning of Jahannam and the path of mercy back to Allah. Every warning is paired with hope, repentance, and practical steps from Qur'an and Sunnah.

/jahannam/duas.title: Duas for Protection from the Fire
/jahannam/duas.description: Supplications from salah, Hisnul Muslim, and the Qur'an seeking Allah's protection from Jahannam — as the Prophet ﷺ taught us to ask in prayer and daily adhkar.

/jahannam/gates.title: Gates of Hell
/jahannam/gates.description: Allah states that Hell has seven gates, each with an assigned portion. Learn what revelation says, and where later interpretations of who enters each gate differ.

/jahannam/hadith.title: Hadith on Jahannam
/jahannam/hadith.description: Authentic narrations on the Fire — warnings, mercy, and protection — presented with collection, citation, and grade where known, alongside their context.

/jahannam/journey.title: The Reality of Jahannam
/jahannam/journey.description: Understand the nature of the Fire as described in revelation — its names, levels, gates, and descriptions — so hearts awaken and return to Allah in repentance.

/jahannam/names.title: Names of Hell in the Qur'an
/jahannam/names.description: The Qur'an uses several names for Hell, each with its own meaning and context. Learn the meanings the texts give and where scholars differ on the levels.

/jahannam/references.title: Jahannam — Sources & References
/jahannam/references.description: The sources behind this module — Qur'an first, then classical tafsir where explanations are given, with differences among scholars noted respectfully.

/jahannam/reflection.title: Daily Reflection on the Hereafter
/jahannam/reflection.description: Self-accountability questions that connect worship to awareness. Pause and ask yourself each one, then open the related tracker or lesson to act on it.

/jahannam/verses.title: Qur'an on Jahannam
/jahannam/verses.description: Curated verses on the Fire, paired with warnings, mercy, repentance, and hope, and brief tafsir. Tap any verse to open it in the Qur'an reader.

/jannah.title: Journey to Jannah — Paradise in Islam
/jannah.description: Paradise, its ranks, and the deeds that elevate a believer, from the Qur'an and authentic Sunnah. Explore the gates, verses, and duas for Jannah.

/jannah/duas.title: Duas for Paradise
/jannah/duas.description: Supplications from Hisnul Muslim asking Allah for Jannah — especially Al-Firdaws — and refuge from the Fire, as the Prophet ﷺ taught us to ask in daily dua.

/jannah/gates.title: Gates of Jannah
/jannah/gates.description: The gates of Paradise named in authentic hadith — opened for those known for prayer, charity, fasting, jihad, and Hajj. Some are called through more than one.

/jannah/journey.title: My Journey to Jannah
/jannah/journey.description: Today's consistency in the worship you already track — salah, adhkar, and reflection. This dashboard shows habits, not your rank with Allah.

/jannah/verses.title: Qur'an on Paradise
/jannah/verses.description: Curated verses on Paradise — its descriptions, ranks, and Allah's mercy — with brief context. Tap any verse to open it directly in the Qur'an reader.

/journal.title: Prayer Journal
/journal.description: Note your presence in each prayer and watch your khushu grow over time. Saved privately on your device.

/last-day.title: The Day of Judgment — The Hereafter
/last-day.description: From death to eternal life according to the Qur'an and authentic Sunnah. Follow the Hereafter journey — resurrection, reckoning, and the signs of the Hour.

/last-day/hadith.title: Hadith on the Last Day
/last-day/hadith.description: Authentic narrations on death, the grave, resurrection, and the reckoning — organised by theme and graded, so weak reports are never presented as certain.

/last-day/preparation.title: Preparing for the Last Day
/last-day/preparation.description: Practical worship habits that prepare you to meet Allah — salah, Qur'an, charity, and repentance — connected to the trackers you already use in the app.

/last-day/progress.title: My Hereafter Learning Progress
/last-day/progress.description: Mark topics complete as you read about the Last Day. This tracks study, not your standing with Allah.

/last-day/quiz.title: The Last Day — Review Quiz
/last-day/quiz.description: Test your understanding of the Hereafter — the timeline, definitions, and reflection. Use it to find gaps, not to measure your standing with Allah.

/last-day/references.title: The Last Day — Sources & References
/last-day/references.description: The Qur'an, hadith collections, and creed texts behind this module — every lesson distinguishing explicit revelation from interpretive scholarly opinion.

/last-day/timeline.title: Timeline of the Hereafter
/last-day/timeline.description: The stages of the Hereafter in order — from life in this world through death, resurrection, reckoning, and eternity. Tap any stage for the full lesson.

/last-day/verses.title: Qur'an on the Last Day
/last-day/verses.description: Curated verses on resurrection, accountability, and Allah's mercy, with brief context and tafsir. Tap any verse to open it in the Qur'an reader.
keywords: Day of Judgment in the Quran

/learn-dua.title: Learn Dua — Meanings & Etiquette
/learn-dua.description: Learn authentic supplications with their meanings, virtues, and best times. Study the etiquette of asking Allah, then practise from the full dua library.

/learn-dua/occasions.title: Duas by Occasion
/learn-dua/occasions.description: Find the right supplication for any moment — daily, situational, and Qur'anic duas organised by occasion. Tap an occasion to open the lesson or full library.

/learn-dua/progress.title: My Dua Learning Progress
/learn-dua/progress.description: Track the dua lessons you have studied. Allah hears every sincere call; this screen tracks your study, not His response.

/learn-quran.title: Learn Qur'an — Read, Understand & Reflect
/learn-quran.description: A complete Qur'an learning journey: read, understand, reflect, memorize, and live the Book of Allah. Lessons cite the Qur'an and authentic hadith throughout.

/learn-quran/apply.title: Apply the Qur'an
/learn-quran/apply.description: Turn reading into action with a daily challenge drawn from a verse. Reading without action was never the goal — build a habit and mark your challenge when done.

/learn-quran/daily.title: Daily Qur'an Lesson
/learn-quran/daily.description: One verse a day with its context, a short reflection, and one action to live it. Small, consistent steps build a lifelong relationship with the Book of Allah.

/learn-quran/learn-to-read.title: Learn to Read the Qur'an
/learn-quran/learn-to-read.description: Seven levels from the alphabet to fluent recitation. Work through each level in order — ideally with a teacher — to read the Qur'an with confidence.

/learn-quran/letters.title: Arabic Letters
/learn-quran/letters.description: The 28 Arabic letters with their names, sounds, and examples. Study one letter a day — see it, hear it, say it, and write it — as a foundation for reading.

/learn-quran/memorization.title: Qur'an Memorization (Hifz)
/learn-quran/memorization.description: Memorization plans from Juz Amma to full hifz. Revision is the secret — never add new ayahs without reviewing what you have already memorized.

/learn-quran/progress.title: My Qur'an Learning Progress
/learn-quran/progress.description: Track the Qur'an lessons you have studied in the app. This dashboard tracks study, not your standing with Allah.

/learn-quran/pronunciation.title: Qur'anic Pronunciation
/learn-quran/pronunciation.description: Master the difficult letter pairs of Arabic. Compare similar sounds side by side, record yourself, and listen back to refine your pronunciation for recitation.

/learn-quran/quiz.title: Qur'an Quiz
/learn-quran/quiz.description: Test your knowledge of surah names, vocabulary, tajweed, and stories from the Qur'an.

/learn-quran/revelation.title: How the Qur'an Was Revealed
/learn-quran/revelation.description: The revelation of the Qur'an — from the Cave of Hira through its preservation. Dates follow commonly-cited seerah chronology, noting where scholars differ.

/learn-quran/stories.title: Stories in the Qur'an
/learn-quran/stories.description: The stories of the prophets from Adam to Muhammad ﷺ as told in the Qur'an — in their accounts is a lesson for those of understanding.

/learn-quran/structure.title: Structure of the Qur'an
/learn-quran/structure.description: How the Qur'an is organised — surahs, juz, hizb, ayahs, and themes. Learn why the mus'haf order differs from the order of revelation, both divinely taught.

/learn-quran/tadabbur.title: Tadabbur — Reflecting on the Qur'an
/learn-quran/tadabbur.description: Guided questions for personal reflection on the Qur'an. Not tafsir — ask what Allah is teaching you in a verse and how you will live it today.

/learn-quran/tajweed.title: Tajweed Rules
/learn-quran/tajweed.description: The rules of correct and beautiful Qur'an recitation. Study each tajweed rule with examples, best paired with audio from a qualified reciter and teacher feedback.

/learn-quran/themes.title: Themes of the Qur'an
/learn-quran/themes.description: The Qur'an by topic — faith, prayer, patience, charity, and more. Verses grouped by theme with related hadith, lessons, and an action item for each.

/learn-quran/vocabulary.title: Qur'anic Vocabulary
/learn-quran/vocabulary.description: Learn the most frequent words of the Qur'an — mastering core vocabulary turns recitation into understanding. Study high-frequency words that unlock meaning.

/location.title: Set Your Location
/location.description: Set the location used to calculate your prayer times and qibla.

/names-of-allah.title: 99 Names of Allah — Asma ul Husna
/names-of-allah.description: The 99 beautiful names of Allah (Asma ul-Husna) with Arabic, transliteration, and meaning. Listen to the recitation of each name — free and offline.

/prophets.title: Learn the Prophets of Islam
/prophets.description: The lives, missions, and lessons of the prophets named in the Qur'an — from Adam to Muhammad ﷺ. Stories drawn from the Qur'an and authentic Sunnah.

/prophets/progress.title: My Prophets Learning Progress
/prophets/progress.description: Mark topics complete as you study the lives of the prophets. This dashboard tracks study, not spiritual rank.

/prophets/timeline.title: Timeline of the Prophets
/prophets/timeline.description: A chronological overview of the prophets across history, from Adam to Muhammad ﷺ, with links to each prophet's story. Eras are approximate where texts are silent.

/qaza.title: Qaza Namaz Tracker — Make Up Missed Prayers
/qaza.description: Track and clear missed (qaza) prayers, one make-up at a time. Per-prayer counters, a daily schedule, and scholar-aware guidance on making up missed salah.

/qaza/calculator.title: Qaza Prayer Calculator — Estimate Missed Salah
/qaza/calculator.description: Estimate a lifetime of missed prayers from your age, puberty age, and years prayed. A simple qaza calculator to turn an overwhelming backlog into a clear number.

/qaza/planner.title: Qaza Planner — A Daily Pace to Clear Your Backlog
/qaza/planner.description: Set a realistic daily pace to make up missed prayers and see an estimated date to clear your qaza backlog. Plan a steady, doable routine.

/qaza/roza.title: Missed Fasts Tracker — Qaza Roza
/qaza/roza.description: Track and make up missed fasts (qaza roza). Estimate missed Ramadan fasts and record each make-up as you go.

/qibla.title: Qibla Direction Finder — Face the Kaaba
/qibla.description: Find the qibla direction toward the Kaaba in Makkah from anywhere. A compass and precise bearing help you face the right direction for prayer.

/quran.title: Read the Qur'an Online — All 114 Surahs
/quran.description: Read and listen to the complete Noble Qur'an offline. Browse all 114 surahs with Arabic text, transliteration, translations, and recitation — free and without ads.

/quran/bookmarks.title: Qur'an Bookmarks
/quran/bookmarks.description: Your saved Qur'an ayahs, kept together for quick return.

/quran/search.title: Search the Qur'an
/quran/search.description: Search the Qur'an by word, translation, or transliteration and jump straight to any ayah. Works fully offline across the bundled translation.

/ramadan.title: Ramadan — Fasting Times & Log
/ramadan.description: Track your Ramadan fasts and see today's suhoor and iftar times for your location. Log each day and follow the blessings of the last ten nights.

/salah-guide.title: Learn Salah — Step by Step
/salah-guide.description: Learn to pray from your first prayer to consistent worship — wudu, every position and recitation, and their meanings, cited from Qur'an and authentic hadith.

/salah-guide/adhan.title: Listen to the Adhan
/salah-guide/adhan.description: Listen to recordings of the adhan and follow along with the words as you learn the call to prayer, its phrases, and their meanings.

/salah-guide/phrases.title: Words of Salah — Phrases & Meanings
/salah-guide/phrases.description: The Arabic phrases you say in prayer, their translation, and the meaning behind each. Understanding what you say builds khushu — read it before your next prayer.

/salah-guide/progress.title: My Salah Learning Progress
/salah-guide/progress.description: Track lessons learned and your daily practice as you study how to pray. This tracks study, not your standing with Allah.

/schedule.title: Today's Schedule
/schedule.description: Obligatory prayers, sunnah windows, and flexible acts of worship laid out for today.

/search.title: Search
/search.description: Search across the Qur'an, hadith, duas, adhkar, duroods, and the 99 Names.

/seerah.title: Seerah Timeline — Life of the Prophet ﷺ
/seerah.description: Key milestones in the life of the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ, drawn from classical seerah sources with commonly-cited CE and AH dates for each event.

/settings.title: Settings
/settings.description: Appearance, notifications, language, and preferences for Munib Tracker.

/settings/about.title: About Munib Tracker
/settings/about.description: About Munib Tracker — credits, content authenticity, privacy policy, and terms of service.

/settings/appearance.title: Appearance
/settings/appearance.description: Choose light, dark, or system theme and your accent color.

/settings/bedtime.title: Bedtime
/settings/bedtime.description: Set when before-sleep adhkar reminders arrive.

/settings/fonts.title: Fonts
/settings/fonts.description: Size the Arabic and translation text you read most.

/settings/language.title: Language
/settings/language.description: Choose the app and translation language.

/settings/notifications.title: Notification Settings
/settings/notifications.description: Choose reminders for salah, qaza, and zikr.

/settings/time-format.title: Time Format
/settings/time-format.description: Show times in a 12-hour or 24-hour clock.

/settings/weather.title: Weather
/settings/weather.description: Home hero weather effects and temperature unit.

/sick.title: Illness & Salah — Concessions
/sick.description: The concessions Islam grants when you are ill — praying sitting or lying down, limited movement, tayammum, and what remains upon you, with hadith evidence.

/statistics.title: Statistics
/statistics.description: Lifetime progress, today's snapshot, and worship trends over time.

/tahajjud.title: Tahajjud — The Night Prayer
/tahajjud.description: Build a lasting habit of the night prayer. Track your Tahajjud streak and read the virtue of standing while others sleep — the best prayer after the fard.

/taharah.title: Learn Purification — Taharah & Wudu
/taharah.description: Learn taharah step by step — wudu, ghusl, tayammum, and removing impurity. Every lesson cites the Qur'an or authentic hadith and notes where scholars differ.

/taharah/checklist.title: Daily Purity Checklist
/taharah/checklist.description: A practical reminder list of purification habits to review each day, keeping you ready for salah — a support for, not a replacement of, learning taharah fiqh.

/taharah/progress.title: My Purification Learning Progress
/taharah/progress.description: Mark taharah topics complete as you study. This dashboard tracks your learning, not spiritual rank.

/tasbeeh/free.title: Digital Tasbeeh Counter — Count Any Dhikr
/tasbeeh/free.description: A free digital tasbeeh (misbaha) counter for any dhikr, hands-free. Count SubhanAllah, Alhamdulillah, Allahu Akbar, durood, or istighfar with a tactile tap.

/tour.title: Guided Tour
/tour.description: A quick guided walkthrough of what you can do in the app — tracking, prayer times, the Qur'an, qibla, adhkar, and more.

/tracker.title: Prayer Tracker
/tracker.description: Log each of today's prayers and keep your streak going. Saved on your device.

/travel.title: Travelling & Salah — Qasr and Jam'
/travel.description: What the Qur'an and Sunnah teach about prayer on a journey — shortening (Qasr) and combining (Jam'), when the concessions apply, and what remains obligatory.

/zakat.title: Zakat Calculator & Guide
/zakat.description: Learn the essentials of zakat and estimate what you owe — 2.5% of qualifying wealth held for one lunar year above nisab — with guides, evidence, and a checklist.

/zakat/checklist.title: Zakat Checklist — Before You Pay
/zakat/checklist.description: A step-by-step review of the common conditions before paying zakat. Work through each item to check your wealth is due — not a substitute for a scholar's ruling.

/zakat/evidence.title: Zakat in the Qur'an & Sunnah
/zakat/evidence.description: The primary texts that establish zakat as a fixed duty on qualifying wealth — not voluntary charity. Read the verses and hadith behind the third pillar of Islam.

/zikr.title: Daily Adhkar & Dhikr — Morning and Evening Remembrance
/zikr.description: Morning, evening, and situational adhkar for every part of your day. Read authentic dhikr with Arabic, transliteration, and meaning, and count along with the tasbeeh.

/zikr/favorites.title: Favorite Adhkar
/zikr/favorites.description: Your favorited adhkar, kept together for quick access.

/hajj/checklist.title: Рӯйхати маросимҳои Hajj
/hajj/checklist.description: Пайгиркунандаи рӯзонаи marosimhoи Hajj az Tarwiyah то tawaf-и хайрбодӣ. Ёдрас дар канори дастури Омӯзиш.

/umrah/checklist.title: Рӯйхати маросимҳои Umrah
/umrah/checklist.description: Рӯйхати tartibii Umrah — ihram, tawaf, sa'i ва halq ё taqsir. Бо дастури Омӯзиши Hajj & Umrah истифода баред.
